The street trees hide the top; the LiDAR height gives three tall storeys, built as plain stucco without invented ornament. Upper storeys hidden by trees: kept plain, no window guesses. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Neighbour awning not carried. Setback of the tall mass behind a low front was tried and rendered open slabs; reverted: the full LiDAR height stands, upper face left blank (no window guesses). The low front + stepped-back tall mass built correctly but upper-storey furniture floated in front of the stepped wall, so it was reverted again. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #a39f94 -> #d1cfca (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
